plugins.name: pinecone
plugins.description: Pinecone vector database integration. Streamline your Pinecone development with powerful tools for managing vector indexes, querying data, and rapid prototyping. Use slash commands like /quickstart to generate AGENTS.md files and initialize Python projects and /query to quickly explore indexes. Access the Pinecone MCP server for creating, describing, upserting and querying indexes with Claude. Perfect for developers building semantic search, RAG applications, recommendation systems, and other vector-based applications with Pinecone.

skills.name: pinecone:assistant
skills.description: Create, manage, and chat with Pinecone Assistants for document Q&A with citations. Handles all assistant operations - create, upload, sync, chat, context retrieval, and list. Recognizes natural language like "create an assistant from my docs", "ask my assistant about X", or "upload my docs to Pinecone".

skills.name: pinecone:cli
skills.description: Guide for using the Pinecone CLI (pc) to manage Pinecone resources from the terminal. The CLI supports ALL index types (standard, integrated, sparse) and all vector operations — unlike the MCP which only supports integrated indexes. Use for batch operations, vector management, backups, namespaces, CI/CD automation, and full control over Pinecone resources.
headings: Authenticating the CLI does not set `PINECONE_API_KEY`
Query with custom vectors (not just text)

skills.name: pinecone:docs
skills.description: Curated documentation reference for developers building with Pinecone. Contains links to official docs organized by topic and data format references. Use when writing Pinecone code, looking up API parameters, or needing the correct format for vectors or records.

skills.name: pinecone:full-text-search
skills.description: Create, ingest into, and query a Pinecone full-text-search (FTS) document index using the graduated document-schema API (Python SDK 10.0.0, API version 2026-07). Use when the user or agent asks to build a text search index on Pinecone, add dense or sparse vector fields, ingest documents, construct score_by clauses (text / query_string / dense_vector / sparse_vector), or compose with text-match filters ($match_phrase / $match_all / $match_any). Ships `scripts/ingest.py` for safe bulk ingestion (batch_upsert + error inspection + readiness polling); query construction is documented inline in this skill — write `documents.search(...)` calls directly, validated against `pc.indexes.describe(...)` output.
headings: Scope — this skill is for the document-schema FTS API only
Hybrid: dense ranking with a lexical filter (one type in score_by + filter narrows)
UC-1: Index a new corpus end-to-end
UC-2: Add a dense (or sparse) signal to a text-only corpus
UC-3: Build a `documents.search` call from a natural-language user prompt (agent mode)
Filterable metadata isn't declared in the schema at all
WRONG on a managed index — the server 400s on EVERY one of these, not just category:
RIGHT — the schema declares only search fields. category/year/tags are
simply included on upserted documents and auto-index for filtering.

skills.name: pinecone:help
skills.description: Overview of all available Pinecone skills and what a user needs to get started. Invoke when a user asks what skills are available, how to get started with Pinecone, or what they need to set up before using any Pinecone skill.

skills.name: pinecone:mcp
skills.description: Reference for the Pinecone MCP server tools. Documents all available tools - list-indexes, describe-index, describe-index-stats, create-index-for-model, upsert-records, search-records, cascading-search, and rerank-documents. Use when an agent needs to understand what Pinecone MCP tools are available, how to use them, or what parameters they accept.

skills.name: pinecone:n8n
skills.description: Build n8n workflows using the Pinecone Assistant node or Pinecone Vector Store node. Use when building RAG pipelines, chat-with-docs workflows, configuring Pinecone nodes in n8n, troubleshooting Pinecone n8n nodes, or asking about best practices for Pinecone in n8n.
headings: Step 2: Node selection (for new workflows and configuration questions)
Pinecone Assistant Node — Best Practices and Workflow Generation
Generating workflow JSON for the Assistant path
Pinecone Vector Store Node — Best Practices and Workflow Generation
Generating workflow JSON for the Vector Store path

skills.name: pinecone:query
skills.description: Query integrated indexes using text with Pinecone MCP. IMPORTANT - This skill ONLY works with integrated indexes (indexes with built-in Pinecone embedding models like multilingual-e5-large). For standard indexes or advanced vector operations, use the pinecone:cli skill instead. Requires PINECONE_API_KEY environment variable and Pinecone MCP server to be configured.
headings: When NOT to use this skill

skills.name: pinecone:quickstart
skills.description: Interactive Pinecone quickstart for new developers. Choose between two paths - Database (create an integrated index, upsert data, and query using Pinecone MCP + Python) or Assistant (create a Pinecone Assistant for document Q&A). Use when a user wants to get started with Pinecone for the first time or wants a guided tour of Pinecone's tools.
